ValidationRule.description: Requires the picklist field for Healthcare Account Storing Records under certain conditions: Primary Service Line: RM Second Service Line: RM Deal Type: [NOT EQUAL TO] Upsell
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( LEFT($Profile.Name,3) <> "IME", OR( ISPICKVAL(NCSP_Service_Line__c,'RM'), ISPICKVAL(Second_Service_Line__c,'RM')), ISBLANK(TEXT(HealthcareAccountStoringPatientRecords__c)), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Deal_Type__c , "Upsell")), (ISCHANGED(NCSP_Service_Line__c) || ISCHANGED(Second_Service_Line__c) || ISCHANGED(Deal_Type__c) || ISCHANGED(HealthcareAccountStoringPatientRecords__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please identify if this RM Deal is for a Healthcare Account Storing Patient Records.
